''See also: [[Sage of Calling Storms Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of Calling Storms is a powerful figure and the sole [[Sage]] within the [[Stormcallers]], a cult dedicated to the [[Weeping Dragon]]. Known for his immense destructive capabilities, he has been described as a one-man force of devastation capable of toppling cities and destroying forests. His abilities involve the use of [[Storm madra|storm madra]], which allows him to manipulate lightning, [[wind]], and [[water]]. He is also noted for his talent in divination, though he has been described as unreliable or useless in certain circumstances. The [[Sage]] is characterized by a manic and crazed personality, often displaying a [[hunger]] for divine truths or witnessing the divine. He has used his powers to perform brutal spiritual attacks, such as mutilating the soul of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel of the Wastelands]]. His combat style includes the use of lightning and regeneration, allowing him to persist even after sustaining significant physical damage. Following his existence, a [[Remnant]] dedicated to chaos remains, which carries on his legacy of defiance and [[destruction]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of Calling Storms is a manic-looking man characterized by pale hair. Blue serpents made of [[Storm madra|storm madra]] encircle his upper arms.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This [[Archlord]] wrestles against the [[Authority|authority]] of [[Fury]] and maintains a belief that they have witnessed the divine. They were once considered the premier diviner among the subordinates of [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] utilizes [[Storm madra|storm madra]] to call [[living lightning]], which crackles with the hungry energy of the [[Weeping Dragon]]. They possess advanced regeneration that allows them to recover even from total [[destruction]] and can use research from the [[Arelius family|Arelius]] [[Monarch]] to damage a target's soul.}}
